title: continously append array will trigger debugger error
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproductible in: v4.4.beta2.official [a013481b0], v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta2 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) HD Graphics 520 - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-6006U CPU @ 2.00GHz (4 threads)

### Issue description

continuously append an array inside `_process`, after array `size()` > 100. it will print error in output.

error is encountered in random array `size()`

this is similar with #94212

### Steps to reproduce

1. download mrp
2. edit project
3. run (F5)
4. go to 'Remote' and select 'Main' node
5. switch back to game window and select 'start' button
6. wait for error in 'Output'
